$comment: Country pop-up (Welcome Page, Figma 76:196; scope 2.3). Shown only on Global (EN + AR), only when the visitor's DETECTED country (edge: functions/_lib/geo.ts via functions/_middleware.ts on Cloudflare or middleware.ts on Vercel -> ch_geo cookie) has an entry under `countries` (bug 083, 9 Oct 2026: AE and SA; every other or unknown country = no pop-up, the visitor stays on Global). Figma has the UAE version only; the SA entry is the same card with KSA text, the pin moved to Riyadh on the same map and no flag (no KSA flag asset exists) until a Figma / client version exists (docs/open-decisions.md B5). Per country: `text` = key in src/data/content/forms/welcome.<locale>.json, `map` / `flag` = image keys under src/assets (`flag` optional), `pin` = top-left of the pin dot in Figma map px (UAE = the Figma position; the chip and line follow it), `buttons[].target` = the edition region saved as the visitor's choice (window.chooseEdition): another region = the SAME page in that region (bug 037: /hospitals -> /ae/hospitals; the edition home when the page does not exist there), the current region = the pop-up just closes. `aeOnGlobal` / `saOnGlobal` = labels that say what the buttons do ('Go to UAE Website' / 'Go to KSA Website' / 'Stay on Global Website'); `ae` = the Figma words written for a visitor already on the UAE site. Closing with Esc counts as 'global'. `remember` = how long a choice is kept (also written by the header region switch): 'forever' = cookie ch_edition for one year (bug 084, 9 Oct 2026; replaces the 5 Oct 'tab' decision), 'session' = until the browser is closed, 'tab' = sessionStorage, back in every new tab / window, 'never' = on every page load. `fallbackCountry` = version shown to a visitor whose country is unknown or has no entry ('' = nothing, bug 083: never assume UAE). `devCountry` = country assumed on a local dev server only (no edge header there) so the pop-up can be seen; ignored in production.
